# Playtest diary: r5-typed-02station

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 02-station
- **Persona:** a retired engineer who enjoys logic puzzles but loses patience with long text
- **Seed:** 6316
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 193caca
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 5
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r5-typed-02station.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmds 1-10.** Climbed out of the truck, docking bay 2, east to Level Five lobby. Opened the survival kit: orange goo, gray goo, Thermos of blue soup. Ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt!) and it cured both hunger and thirst; the game told me I'd be hungry again in ~100 moves. Handy - I like being told the clock.

**Cmds 11-25.** Workshop north of lobby: took a twenty-ohm bedistor. Storage beyond it is dark (need a light). A hull welder "quivering with excitement" keeps approaching - I step away each time; it feels hostile. Sick Bay has an ID-reader security door east; my ID card does nothing. East Connection: iris hatch with a slot (Military Sub-Module). Comm Center has a blank screen and beacon. Station Control monitors: COMM, FOOD red, PRINTING yellow. Met Plato, Floyd's new bookish robot friend.

**Cmds 26-45.** Commander's Office has a fixed log reader; took the log tape from the Commander's Quarters desk and played it. Long, but useful: fuel cells locked in the Dome's storage bin, key in the commander's safe (dial, 8000 settings, 12-20 numbers - not guessable); the stamp was hidden under the bed (found it: validation stamp); alien pyramid moved to Sci Sub-Module holding tank; sabotage of simple machines; welders malfunctioning. Heard an explosion nearby - I bet the log reader overheated. Plan: find a light, the village, the Dome.

**Cmds 46-88.** Explosion confirmed: log reader is now a black scar. Briefing Room, South Connection (another slotted iris hatch), Robot Shop: dormant robot "Oliver" and a heating chamber holding a drill bit that's too hot / too small an opening for a human hand. Asked Floyd to fetch it - he did, dropped it, it cooled, +3 (score 8). Nice. File Room (off South Junction) is dark. Level 4: barracks (nothing), Docking Bay 3 had a lilac nanofilm spool. Level 3: Gym has an exercise machine with a sign warning about frequency 710 (so something radio-ish will sabotage it, or is the saboteur); Theatre projection booth locked; Laundry missing its washer (sabotaged?), presser; Chapel has a blinking star (a code? I suspect it's a message) and a puce spool.

**Cmds 89-125.** Level 2 Mess Hall: mysteriously steaming coffee. Main Storage: a detonator; opened it and found a blackened hyperdiode (broken part to replace). Meeting rooms 1 & 2, Library with voice spool reader (terminal removed). Got muddled over 'read spool' - I thought it was in the reader but it was on the floor after a fumble (7-item hand limit). A second welder (No. 2) cornered me in the Library; fled north and it left. Spools, both corrupted with "You will die, human!": lilac = spacetruck refueling (quarnum wrench), puce = chapel maintenance "...iode in the Chapel's star". So: the star's diode could replace the detonator's burnt hyperdiode - need to reach the high star. Dome (top): the locked warm storage bin (fuel cells), grating. I'm getting weary - need a bunk.

**Cmds 126-175.** Took the elevator (keypad: "type 6") down, then climbed to the Male Barracks and slept ("get in bed"; "bunk" unknown). Woke Novem 5, +3 (score 11); I'd dropped everything on the bed - "take all" had a funny bit where I try to lift Floyd. Read my form - a course chart for time ranges (will matter for flying the truck home). Stamped the form (no points). Level 6: doors now open sluggishly and slam fast - sabotage creeping in. Aux barracks/SanFac (exits unclear), Docking Bay 1 with the alien ship: empty pedestal (pyramid went to Sci module), skeleton with a big "tongue case", and dot patterns on the wall (groups 2 2 / 2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3 / 2 3 1 / 4 1 3 1 / 2 3 1 - looks like a language or number code). Docking Bay 4 empty. Officers' Quarters A/B/C and SanFac - nothing. End of Corridor: another ID security door north, dark Shipping Room east. Ate the gray goo when hungry.

**Cmds 176-218.** Level 7 Printing Plant: trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form (stamped it - maybe it needs pressing in the Laundry presser too), mauve spool. Paper Recycling: a tired drill with a small bit. Ladder to Level 8 sealed from below; elevator whines and won't go to 8. Dome: "drill lock" warned the drill has one job left; I then typed "drill bin" and the game said it could no longer be won - UNDO saved me (thank you). Comm Center screen: the Duffy says abort the assignment and come home - so I need fuel cells (bin, key in safe). Drilled the safe instead: toothpick hole, no loss notice, drill still "tired". Theory: pack the hole with explosive, add the detonator (after fixing its hyperdiode with the chapel star's diode), and blow the safe. Need explosive and a way up to the star.

**Cmds 219-250.** North Junction -> North Connection -> Tube -> Science Sub-Module (5 levels on gangways): Engineering Office had Schmidt's diary (ship/pyramid over a billion years old; the wall dots had "nonvisual properties" and "my pal the mayor" knows linguistics - so the dots may be tactile/tasted, cf. the skeleton's big tongue case; the mayor is presumably in the village). Astro Lab: twenty-prong fromitz board (left it, hands full). Scientists' Quarters nothing. Bio Office: note - "think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacteriophage", blood-stained. Holding Tank: blasted open from inside, empty. So the pyramid is loose and infecting machines. Welder No. 2 chased me at East Junction again.

**Cmds 251-285.** PX (east of North Connection): Vendo-Matic, 1 galakmid each; only an All-Purpose Timer (6) and a Large Drill Bit (9) are in stock. A timer - surely for the explosive. Need a coin. Storage west of North Connection is dark. My ID card gets spat back by the Military hatch slot (need a better card - Shady Dan's modified IDs?). Chapel: climbing the pulpit made it sway; opened it, found a switch that turns the eternal flame off/on. Still can't reach the star. Mauve spool: collater repair - "check the lower fromitz ... replace with ..." - ties to the fromitz board in the Astro Lab. Feel like I'm collecting parts without a clear next lock to open. Welders now numbered 2, 3, 4.

**Cmds 286-340.** Tried to find a coin and a light, without luck. Coffee is now cold. Truck: SB radio is missing its microphone. Floyd says "ask Plato"; Plato never knows anything ("I'll look it up in the library") - I suspect he fills in later. Ironed the crumpled village entry form in the Laundry presser (open, put, close, turn on, open): now a neat, validated Illegal Space Village Entry Form - no points yet, no idea where the village is. Gym machine: can get in and exercise, harmless so far. Theatre booth still locked. Mess Hall food unit sprays ACID now - sabotage everywhere. Main Storage: "stockpiles"/"organic" unknown words, search finds nothing. Patience wearing: lots of red herrings and no coin.

**Cmds 341-400.** Tasted the alien dots (deduced from the diary's "nonvisual properties" + tongue case): a taste-language transcript - saved for the mayor. Shipping Room stays dark. Doors now "almost nip your heels". Plato ("were I several meters taller") and Floyd ("shorter even than you") can't reach the chapel star; throwing a drill bit missed. Station Control: life support/gravity yellow, power and printing red - things are decaying. Finally put the ironed village entry form in the South Connection slot: hatch half-opens, +6 (score 17). Weightless grimy passage south to the village: Main Street (exits up, NE, S, W, SE ramp down), Travel Agency (W; exits E, SE). Leg ended there.

## Leg handoff

Score 17, Novem 5, time ~5621, standing in the Travel Agency (space village). Undo is on.

### Map so far
- **L1 Dome** (top): elevator, ladder, air shaft grating (affixed), locked welded storage bin (warm; fuel cells inside, key in the commander's safe).
- **L2 Mess Hall**: N and S doors both to Main Storage (curved), NE Meeting Room 1 -> S Meeting Room 2 -> S Library (W back to Mess Hall). FDU sprays acid. Library: spool reader; lilac, puce spools + log tape on floor, mauve spool in reader.
- **L3**: N Gym (exercise machine, frequency-710 sign), S Theatre (booth locked), NW Laundry (presser, dryer), SW Chapel (high blinking star + flame; pulpit opens, switch toggles flame).
- **L4**: N/S barracks (+ SanFac between), W Docking Bay 3.
- **L5**: W Docking Bay 2 (my truck; radio lacks mic), N Workshop -> N Storage (dark); NE North Junction (E Sick Bay w/ ID security door east; N North Connection: W Storage (dark), E PX, N Tube to Science module), SE South Junction (SW File Room dark; E Station Control; SE Commander's Office -> E Quarters (safe, drilled), S Briefing -> W South Connection -> W Robot Shop (dormant Oliver), S village. East Junction -> E East Connection (Military hatch, slot rejects my ID; S Comm Center).
- **Science module** (gangways): Scientists' Qtrs / Astro Lab (fromitz board) + office / Engineering Lab + office (Schmidt's diary) / Bio Lab + office (note) / Holding Tank (blasted open, empty).
- **L6**: NW Docking Bay 1 (alien ship: dots, skeleton, empty pedestal), SW Docking Bay 4 (empty), N Aux Barracks/SanFac, S Officers' Qtrs A/B/C + SanFac, SE End of Corridor (N ID security door, E Shipping Room dark).
- **L7** Printing Plant (trash can), NW Paper Recycling. Ladder to L8 sealed from below; elevator won't go to 8.
- **Village**: Grimy Passage -> Main Street -> W Travel Agency.

### Puzzles solved
Eat/drink from survival kit; Floyd fetches the hot drill bit (+3); log tape and stamp under the bed; sleep in a bed (+3); iron crumpled village form (presser) + stamp it; form in South Connection slot opens the village (+6); taste the dots for the alien text.

### Open puzzles and theories
- Safe: drilled a toothpick hole. Theory: explosive in the hole + detonator (replace blackened hyperdiode with the chapel star's diode, per the puce spool) + PX timer (needs a 1-galakmid coin). Key -> Dome bin -> fuel cells -> refuel truck (lilac spool: quarnum wrench) -> fly home with the course chart on my form.
- Drill is "tired" - one or two uses left. Don't drill the bin (game warned it's unwinnable - undone).
- Reaching the chapel star: unknown. Gravity is yellow; maybe low gravity later helps?
- Light for dark rooms (Workshop Storage, North Storage, File Room, Shipping Room): none found.
- Mayor in the village should translate the taste transcript. Shady Dan may sell a modified ID for the security doors / Military hatch.
- Mauve spool: collater fix needs a fromitz board (Astro Lab).
- Sabotage is escalating: welders stalk you, doors nip heels, FDU acid. The pyramid is loose ("mechanized bacteriophage").

### What I would try next
Explore the village fully (Main Street up/NE/S/SE; look for the mayor, Shady Dan, a coin, a light, explosive). Buy the timer at the PX. Then assemble the safe-cracking kit.

# Playtest diary: r5-typed-04day1end

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 04-day1-end
- **Persona:** a 14-year-old who has never played a text adventure, used to phone games
- **Seed:** 84412
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 193caca
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 5
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r5-typed-04day1end.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmds 1-36.** Woke up in the game at night-ish in Officers' Quarters B with two robot buddies (Floyd, Plato). Typed "sleep": told to use a bed, but no room text ever says there's a bed. Guessed "get in bed" in Officers' Quarters C and it worked - new day (Novem 5), +3 points (26). My stuff got dropped on the floor; "take all" funny with Floyd. Welder robots keep coming at me "with excitement" - I zapped one with the zapgun and it vanished. Used ID card in the reader to open Armory (empty). Level 7 printing plant: took a mauve nanofilm spool. Ladder to Level 8 sealed from below; elevator won't go to 8. Took elevator to 1: Dome garden, locked bin "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies". Drill warned me it has one job left - so I'm saving it.

**Cmds 37-70.** Dome grating is stuck. Level 2 Mess Hall: coffee on a table. The game said "you'll be able to eat once you're hungry, in about 2 moves", so I waited and drank it... POISONED, died. Used undo (glad it exists). Ate the orange goo instead (apricot yogurt!). Food machine sprayed acid at me - the station machines are going evil. Found Meeting Rooms 1-2 and the Library; put the mauve spool in the reader and after static it said "You will die, human!" Creepy. Level 3: Gym (exercise machine; sign warns about frequency 710 - remember that), Laundry (presser steaming, dryer empty), Theatre with a locked projection booth. Welders keep chasing me.

**Cmds 71-110.** Chapel (Level 3 SW): blinking star up high, eternal flame, puce spool. Puce spool in the reader: chapel maintenance - flame fuel reservoir, and a "diode in the Chapel's star". PA says a deep-space message is waiting at the Comm Center (no idea where that is yet). Level 4: barracks (nothing), Docking Bay #3 with a lilac spool. Level 5 north: Workshop with a twenty-ohm bedistor, dark Storage beyond. Tried to take the bedistor and dropped stuff: 7-item hand limit (the note explained it, good). Plastic bag has vacuum taffy; I put a spool in it. Found out my headlamp is DEAD now (was working last night) so Storage stays dark. Back to my Spacetruck in Docking Bay #2.

**Cmds 111-172.** Spacetruck radio has no microphone. North Junction -> Sick Bay -> Brig (ID card, empty cells). East Connection -> Comm Center: message says the forms were found, abort and go home (lol). Station Control monitors: lots of RED. File Room (off South Junction SW) is dark - no light. Commander's Quarters: safe + log tape. Drilled the safe: toothpick-sized hole (drill used up?). Inventory limit made me drop the nectar in the Quarters. Played the tape in the log reader in Commander's Office: fuel cells locked in the Dome bin, KEY IN THE SAFE; alien ship with a pyramid in Docking Bay #1, pyramid moved to holding tank in Sci Sub-Module; Shady Dan sells fake ID cards; commander hid the STAMP UNDER HIS BED; gym + laundry sabotage. The reader whined louder and louder, and I kept pressing... it exploded and killed me. Undo only goes back one move and that move was already doomed. Restarting the checkpoint. Lesson: SAVE.

**Restart from 04-day1-end at command 173.**

**Cmds 173-215 (second try).** Slept in Officers' Quarters B this time (bed works there too) and SAVED. Turned the headlamp OFF overnight and it still works in the morning - last time I'd left it on and it died. So it was my fault, but nothing told me it was draining. Took bedistor again. Storage (dark room N of Workshop) has a JAMMER: black box, antenna, 20 tiny sockets, frequency 0-1400 set to 337. Frequency 710 = gym machine! Couldn't carry it (juggling). North Connection -> Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module: Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary: pyramid is a billion years old, alien dots read by "nonvisual properties", "my pal the mayor" has linguistic training), Astro Lab has a TWENTY-PRONG FROMITZ BOARD (fits the jammer's 20 sockets?), Bio Lab, Holding Tank blasted open and EMPTY - pyramid escaped. Bio Office note: "station is a cell, pyramid is a mechanized bacteriophage".

**Cmds 216-267.** Put the fromitz board in the jammer (fits!), dropped the plastic bag in Storage to carry the jammer, set jammer to 710 (off). Stamp is NOT under the commander's bed (maybe taken on day 1). Drilled the safe for real: tiny hole; drill probably done. Opened the detonator: blackened hyperdiode inside - took it; I think the Chapel star's diode is the replacement. Chapel: pulpit is openable, has a switch -> flame went OUT. Can't reach the star: jump is half a meter short, pulpit sways when I climb it, Floyd/Plato too short. Taking off mag boots warns my ID card would be wiped (nice). Saved in Bio Office.

**Cmds 268-302.** Gym: got in the exercise machine; jammer ON at 710 = "machine seems to be frozen"; off = normal reps. No reward yet - maybe useful later when the machine turns evil. Thermos is open and empty. Level 6: Auxiliary Barracks + SanFac (SanFac says no exits; only n works - wasted turns), Officers' Quarters A (south). NW huge door = Docking Bay #1 with the ALIEN SHIP: empty pedestal (pyramid was on it), dots on the wall, skeleton (crumbled to dust when I searched it - oops). Touch/smell/listen to dots: nothing. Schmidt said the mayor (village) can read them.

**Cmds 303-336.** Docking Bay #4 empty. PX (NE of North Junction) has a vending machine: 1 galakmid each; still has an ALL-PURPOSE TIMER (#6) and LARGE DRILL BIT (#9) - timer + detonator + something = open the safe? I have no money. Into the village (weightless): Field Office, Recruitment Office, Rec Shop (simulation booth does nothing), Barbershop. Broadway says "openings in virtually every direction" - I have to guess them. "mayor" is not a known word even though Schmidt's diary names him. Tester note: I fired several moves without reading each one in between (my mistake, breaking my own rule) and a welder that was warning me for 3 turns fried me in the Barbershop. Undo back one, zapped it.

**Cmds 337-400.** Grocery (bare shelves). Trading Post: 12-prong fromitz board + FREZONE instruction sheet (liquid explosive: put in hole, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep below 150 K). Sign says "ask for it" - "ask for explosive" isn't understood. Down to Warehouse -> vacuum storage airlock; opened the lower door with no suit and my lungs burst (undo). Alley -> Main Street -> UP = Mayor's Office: textbook "Deciphering Alien Speech", a paper fell out = a TASTE glossary. Went back to the alien ship and TASTED the dots - decoded it myself: the Zeenak weapon's only weakness is element 78 (platinum - I know that from chemistry class/memory, not the screen), "turn back the evil radiations". Best moment. File Room (lit with headlamp): nothing. South Connection: the VALIDATION STAMP and my Assignment Completion Form QX-17-T were lying there; stamped the form (no points). Ended in the village Travel Agency, score 26. Saved at South Connection.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- Command Module (ladder/elevator stack): L1 Dome (locked bin "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" = fuel cells, grating stuck); L2 Mess Hall (poisoned coffee, acid food units), Main Storage N, Meeting Rooms 1-2 NE, Library SE (spool reader); L3 Gym N, Laundry NW, Theatre S (locked projection booth), Chapel SW (star, flame now off, pulpit switch); L4 barracks N/S, Docking Bay #3 W; L5 Workshop N -> Storage (dark) -> North Connection -> Tube -> Sci Sub-Module (Eng/Astro/Bio labs+offices, Scientists' Quarters, empty Holding Tank); Docking Bay #2 W (spacetruck); NE North Junction -> PX (NE), Sick Bay E -> Brig; East Junction/East Connection -> Comm Center S, Station Control SW, village E; SE South Junction -> Commander's Office SE -> Quarters E (safe with toothpick hole), File Room SW, South Connection S -> Grimy Passage -> village; L6 Aux Barracks N, Officers' Qtrs A S, Docking Bay #1 NW (alien ship), #4 SW, End of Corridor E (Officers' B/C, SanFac, Shipping Room, Armory); L7 Printing Plant; ladder to L8 sealed from below, elevator won't go to 8.
- Village (zero-g): Broadway (Field Office E, Recruitment N, Rec Shop NE, Barbershop SE), Grocery, Trading Post (down: Warehouse -> vacuum airlock; SW Alley), Greasy Straw, Main Street (up: Mayor's Office; W Travel Agency).

### Puzzles solved
Slept (bed exists in Officers' Quarters though undescribed), jammer assembled (20-prong board), alien dots decoded by taste, form validated.

### Open puzzles and theories
- Safe (key to Dome bin -> fuel cells): drilled hole; need FREZONE explosive (probably in the vacuum storage below the Trading Post - need a spacesuit, keep it cold in the Thermos), an all-purpose TIMER (PX vending, 1 galakmid - need money, casino?), and a new hyperdiode for the detonator (the old one is blackened; the Chapel star's diode? star is half a meter out of reach). Hyperdiode left on the floor at South Connection.
- Pyramid escaped; weakness is element 78 (platinum). Find platinum.
- Jammer at 710 freezes the gym machine - probably for later when the machine attacks.
- Welders hunt you: zap them early. Log reader explodes if you keep playing the tape (take the tape out when it whines).

### What I would try next
Find a spacesuit and money; get the timer; reach the star (stand on something steadier?); look for platinum; find how to reach Level 8.

Kick, reach (can feel it, can't grip), Floyd, and magnetic boots in the hole all failed. Taking the boots off warned me they'd wipe my ID card -- nice. Leg ends in The PX, score 44/80, starving. Floyd is fully rude now.

## Leg handoff

Ended: The PX (Level 5, NE of North Junction), score 44 of 80, day 2, time 7477, SAVE made in the Trading Post (score 38, before the suit/airlock trip). Undo is on. **Very hungry/thirsty ('feeling faint') -- starvation is close.** Floyd is with me and turning nasty; Plato is dead.
Carrying: magnetic boots (worn), medium drill bit, jammer (set 337), survival kit (bedistor, lilac + mauve spools, ostrich nip, Thermos), zapgun (~2 charges), detonator (with good J-series hyperdiode), headlamp (DEAD), uniform (pocket: alien flavour glossary paper, ID card), chronometer.

- Elevator keypad: 1 Dome, 2 Mess Hall, 3 Level Three, 4 Level Four, 5 Level Five, 6 Level Six, 7 Printing Plant; 8 refuses. Ladders link all levels (7->8 sealed).

East Connection: Comm Center (S; shocking beacon; 'abort, return to Duffy' message), Station Control (SW) -> Commander's Office (S; log reader, no tape) -> Briefing Room (S) -> South Connection (W; completion form + stamp on floor) -> Robot Shop (W; sleeping robot Oliver, heating chamber). Docking Bay #2 (W of Level Five) = spacetruck. South Junction between.

Alley: S Loan Shark (box opened), E Junk Yard -> up Shady Dan's (rank machine) -> NW Trading Post. Trading Post: down Warehouse -> Airlock -> In Space (DARK vacuum storage), W Studio, NW Pet Store (balloon creature), N Grocery -> N Broadway (Recruitment, Rec Shop, Field Office, Barbershop, Fortune Teller down, Makeshift Connector W), SE Saloon -> E Casino (dice, roulette) -> N Opium Den, up Flophouse.

- Explosive plan (FREZONE sheet): drill hole with medium bit (drill has 'one job left'), explosive from vacuum storage kept cold in the Thermos, detonator + timer. The timer is stuck in the PX dispenser (coin spent).

- Fromitz boards (12- and 20-prong) + the collater repair spool: fix the collater at the Printing Plant?

### What I would try next
Eat first (fetch the taffy from the Bank). Find a light. Try harder on the PX timer (hit/shake the machine, put the drill bit/zapgun in the hole?). Then vacuum storage for the explosive with the Thermos, get the drill from Storage once lit, and look for the alien ship/pyramid.

# Playtest diary: r5-typed-07factory

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** checkpoint 07-factory
- **Persona:** a fast-moving gamer who tries everything on screen quickly and hates reading instructions
- **Seed:** 76477
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** on (--undo on, D18: early rounds only)
- **Build commit:** 193caca
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 5
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-25/r5-typed-07factory.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Commands 1-10.** I start in Computer Control at 73 points with a zapgun, a jammer, reflective foil and magnetic boots, and the P.A. says "Launch in 200 millichrons." The call button does nothing. North goes to the bottom of the elevator shaft, which is a dead end. The ladder goes up to the Factory on Level Eight (+2 points): rows of replica pyramids, the original on a pedestal, and an evil Floyd with an eye patch and a stun ray, who stuns my leg. I turned on the jammer on a hunch; a reactor light went from yellow to red, which scared me. Shooting the pyramid did nothing (it glows, then cools). When I tried to take the pyramid, Floyd waved me off.

**Commands 11-19.** I shot Floyd with the zapgun and he slumped against the pedestal. The pyramid is too heavy to lift. I took his stun ray and died on the spot: the station blew apart and the reactor went H-bomb. It was the launch clock, but it read as if the stun ray were a trap. I undid it. Memory, not the screen, said the foil was the key (the screen did call it "reflective"). PUT FOIL ON PYRAMID reflects its emanations back into it, it explodes, the launch aborts, Floyd dies apologising, and Oliver asks to play. **Won, 80/80, Intergalactic Mega-Hero.** A strong ending.

**Replay, commands 20-31.** I restarted the checkpoint to probe. THROW FOIL AT PYRAMID gives "You missed" and the foil lands on the floor. PUT FOIL ON PYRAMID while Floyd is up gets the "Floyd levels his stun ray" block, which is consistent. TALK TO FLOYD gives "Hmmm... Floyd looks at you expectantly" and FLOYD, DROP STUN RAY gives "Shut up!", both fitting. This time I left the jammer off: shoot Floyd, put the foil on the pyramid, and I won again. The jammer is not needed here.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
Computer Control: N to Shaft at Level Nine (dead end, no elevator); UP to Factory (Level Eight).

### Puzzles solved
- The endgame: SHOOT FLOYD (zapgun), then PUT FOIL ON PYRAMID. Won with 80/80, twice, the second time without the jammer.

### Open puzzles and theories
- None. The game is won. What the jammer does here is unclear; the reactor lights turn red with or without it.

### What I would try next
- Nothing needed. A later tester could check whether the launch clock can be read (no countdown was visible after the checkpoint's "200 millichrons"), and whether the inventory panel keeps showing the foil after the win.

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Cmds 1-14.** Woke up in the pilot seat with FLOYD next to me - my heart! The truck wanted a course heading. The form opened in a lovely paper viewer showing the green feelie with an astrogator table; clock read 5364, so row 5350-5399 = 259. Typed 259 via the keypad entry, launched. A phantom "village" entry popped up in the room list after examining Floyd and said "You can't see any village here" (bug; later the village legitimately appears out the viewport on approach). Opened the survival kit: orange goo, gray goo, Thermos. Eating early was refused ("hungry in about 7 moves" - nice hint). Ate orange goo (apricot yogurt!) once hungry. Docked in bay #2 (+5), nobody to meet us. Opened hatch, went out.

**Cmds 15-44.** Station is deserted; a hull welder "quivering with excitement" keeps approaching then wandering off (unnerving). Level Five lobby (elevator, ladder up/down). Workshop N: took a twenty-ohm bedistor (Planetfall memory - fuse!). Storage north of it is pitch black ("hope there are no grues"). North Junction -> Sick Bay (security door with ID reader: my card does nothing). East Connection: iris hatch to Military Sub-Module, slot. Comm Center: emergency beacon button (not pressing yet), blank screen. Station Control: board shows COMMUNICATION and FOOD PRODUCTION red, PRINTING yellow. Commander's Office: fixed log reader (no tape). Briefing Room, South Connection (Diplomatic hatch + slot), Robot Shop with dormant robot Oliver and a heating chamber holding a drill bit. Hand too big - fetched Floyd and told him to take it; he dropped it hot, I took it (+3). Floyd's speech about waking up lonely: lovely.

**Cmds 45-80.** South Junction, File Room (dark), East Junction close the Level Five ring. PX: Vendo-Matic, items cost 1 galakmid; only All-Purpose Timer (6) and Large Drill Bit (9) in stock - need a coin. North Connection: met Plato, an old poetry-reading robot; Floyd befriends him. Scientific Sub-Module via Tube: Engineering Lab/Office (Prof. Schmidt's diary: billion-year-old alien pyramid from a derelict ship, dot markings with "nonvisual properties", "my pal, the mayor" has linguistic training; lab machines failing). Astro Lab: took twenty-prong fromitz board (Planetfall memory again!). Astro Office, Scientists' Quarters (beds - sleepy in ~20 moves). Bio Lab / Bio Office: bloodstained note "think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph..." Creepy. The pyramid is the villain, I suspect.

**Cmds 81-125.** Holding Tank Level: isolation tank blasted open from inside, empty (the pyramid got out!). Went to bed in Scientists' Quarters early; "not tired, in about 12 moves" - had to click Wait ~6 times (each Wait is only ~2 moves out of transit). Slept, woke Novem 5 (+3), everything dropped; "Take all" button picked it up in one click. Level Four: auto-doors now open "sluggishly" and slam early - something is sabotaging machinery (pyramid again?). Female/Male Barracks (cubicles empty), SanFac. Docking Bay #3: lilac nanofilm spool "Spacetruck Refueling Instructions" (need a reader - library? Plato keeps it). Hands full: tucked note into uniform, dropped diary; Floyd picked the diary up and tucked it under his arm - cute. Ate gray goo when hungry.

**Cmds 126-144.** Level Three: Gym (exercise machine; sign warns its diagnostics talk on frequency 710 - nothing broadcasting on 710 allowed near it. The truck's SB radio? A puzzle!). Laundry: washer missing(!), dryer empty, presser (opened, off). Theatre: projection booth locked (lock visible; drill bit?). Chapel: blinking seven-pointed star out of reach, eternal flame; pulpit hides a switch that turns the flame off/on (put it back on). Puce spool "Chapel Maintenance Procedures". Floyd's Lazarus memory and Plato comforting him - beautiful. Level Two: Mess Hall with a cup of coffee and food dispensers.

**Cmds 145-193.** Main Storage: detonator (opened: blackened hyperdiode) - Floyd and Plato went off to play hide-and-seek; P.A.: "Deep-space communication received at Comm Center" (haven't gone to read it yet!). Meeting Rooms 1-2, Library: nanofilm reader. Lilac spool: truck refuelling ("quarnum wrench", "fuel cell opening"), puce spool: chapel flame fuel reservoir and the star's "...iode" - both end in a laughing voice "You will die, human!". So the star holds a hyperdiode to replace the blackened one? Dome on top: locked "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin, air shaft grating. Elevator works (keypad by level). Level Six: Aux Barracks/SanFac, Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac, End of Corridor with another ID-reader security door, Shipping Room (dark). Docking Bay #1: the alien ship! Empty pedestal (the pyramid's), skeleton with big tongue case, wall dots. Tasting the dots gives flavour groups - a taste language (saved in scratch dots.txt). "The mayor" can translate, per Schmidt's diary - the village!

**Cmds 194-258.** Docking Bay #4 empty. Level Seven = Printing Plant: trash can with a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q (not validated); mauve spool "Collater Repair Manual". Paper Recycling Plant: a drill (small bit, motor "sounds tired"). Ladder down to Level Eight sealed from below; dread vibrations, clanging, a throbbing "mechanical heart" below - the pyramid's lair. Comm Center message: my mission is cancelled, return to the Duffy (ha!). Crumpled form won't fit the East Connection slot. Ironed it in the Laundry presser (closed, on, wait, it billowed steam, off, open) -> neatly ironed form. Discovered the Papers button lists 9 blueprints of the station - a map I hadn't noticed. Drilled the Theatre booth lock with small and then medium bits: "point not as hard as the lock". Probably need the Large Drill Bit from the Vendo-Matic (1 galakmid).

Found Commander's Office has an east exit: Commander's Quarters with a HyperSecurity safe (8000-setting dial) and a log tape. Log tape in the office reader (push red button repeatedly): fuel cells locked in Dome bin, key in the safe; Shady Dan in the village sells modified Patrol ID cards; alien craft+pyramid; forms validation stopped; the stamp hidden UNDER THE BED; sabotage of gym/laundry equipment. Reader started whining/overheating - turned it off, tape still in it. Looked under the Commander's bed: validation stamp. Validated the ironed form; South Connection slot accepted it, hatch jammed half-open (+6, score 17). A welder is shadowing me.

Grocery (plastic bag of vacuum taffy - food, left it). Broadway hub, Recruitment Office (Planetfall nostalgia!), Rec Shop (sim booths), Field Office: headlamp - now worn, so the dark Storage/File Room/Shipping Room are reachable.

**Cmds 314-352.** Barbershop: detector beeped; broke the mirror -> reflective foil (+4, score 21). Makeshift Connector W of Broadway leads back toward East Connection. Pet Store: Arcturian balloon creature on a leash - in zero-gee it can't float, and grabbing the leash makes it fart in my face and I drop everything (lol). Floyd can't be told to take the leash. Probably needs gravity (lead it into the station to reach the chapel star?). Saloon, Casino (dice, roulette). Trading Post down -> Warehouse -> airlock to a VACUUM storage area (explosive kept cold there? need a suit; "secure all open containers"). Alley, Loan Shark (strong box, HUGE lock). Junk Yard (odd "Studio" text printed first): magnetic spaceboots - refused to pick them up because they'd wipe my ID card. Shady Dan's: the ID-rank machine! Card now rank 10, Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral. Saved there.

I finally got the Studio/Junk Yard joke - each room is first mistaken for the other. Back to the station through the Makeshift Connector (East Connection hatch now frozen open). **164-200.** East Connection NW -> Sick Bay; my HyperAdmiral card opened the security door (just an empty Brig, though - a bit of a letdown). North Junction -> North Connection -> Tube -> Science Sub-Module: Engineering Lab/Office (Schmidt's diary: the alien dots have "nonvisual properties", the Mayor's linguistics - so the taste glossary is for LICKING the dots in the alien ship at Docking Bay #1!), Astro Lab (20-prong fromitz board, left), Scientists' Quarters, Bio Office (bloodstained note: "station as a cell, pyramid as a mechanized bacteriophage"), Holding Tank blasted open and empty. **Cmds 21-37.** Went up to the Trading Post: a twelve-prong fromitz board and the FREZONE instruction sheet float there. The sheet: insert in a hole, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; do not keep it above 150 K for long. Then Plato shot me with a stun ray and monologued: a Zeenak pyramid, a weapon that turns machines against their makers, is building copies here. Floyd was lost ("Floyd in quandary") whatever I told him, then knocked the gun away; it blew Plato apart (+7, 61). Meanwhile the explosive melted and sublimed, and the game told me plainly it was now unwinnable. Good of it.

**Cmds 38-55.** Restarted the checkpoint. This time I took the Thermos out of the kit first, shot a hull welder that came at me in the warehouse (zapgun vaporised it), cycled the airlock, took the explosive in space, put it in the Thermos and closed it. Saved in space. Back in the warehouse with Plato and Floyd.

**Cmds 56-80.** Shot a second welder (Number 2) in the Trading Post, took the sheet. West is the "Junk Yard", which the game then re-heads as the Studio: a scrap sculpture with a J-series hyperdiode, which I took (I already carry an M-series; the two must matter). Plato's ambush came in the Studio. This time I just waited through the monologue and died: Floyd ran off crying. One-step undo, then "Floyd, save me": Floyd tackled the gun and Plato blew up (+7, 61). So pleading with Floyd is the key; last time I'd been pleading without knowing it mattered. Ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt). Juggling inventory is a chore; the suit counts against my hands when not worn. Saved. Need: a detonator, and wherever the pyramid is.

**Cmds 81-112.** Shady Dan's (SE of the Trading Post) has an "innocuous machine" with a keypad (0-9999) and a tiny slot, no code known. While there the game warned the explosive was softening even in the sealed Thermos, so I hauled it back to the vac yard and left it floating there. Even out in the vacuum it keeps saying "getting softer", so I can't tell whether it's safe. Looked at the blueprints: Levels Eight (power plant, arti-grav, oxygen, water) and Nine (computer control) are the bottom of the command module, and I've never been below Level Six. My theory: the pyramid is down there and the explosive opens the way. Heading back into the station to look, with a detonator also on my list.

**Cmds 113-142.** Village: Missionary (kook, nothing), Travel Agency, Bank (a platinum detector, which beeped when I turned it on), Mayor's Office (textbook "Deciphering Alien Speech" with a slip of paper: a taste-based glossary of Zeenak/Hunji words). Grimy Passage north of Main Street goes to the station, but the half-open iris won't pass a space suit, even carried, so I left the suit there. In the station: Level Six has Auxiliary Barracks (beds, for when I'm sleepy) and Docking Bay #1 with an alien ship: an empty pedestal, a skeleton, and dots. Tasting the dots and decoding them with the glossary: "Hunji brethren, sabotage failed. However, I have found the Zeenak weapon's single weakness: element 78 [platinum]! Turn back the deadly radiations!" So platinum shields against the pyramid. The detector beeped in the bank while my reflective foil was in my kit: my guess is the foil is platinum.

**Cmds 143-175.** Swept Level Six: Docking Bay #4 (empty), Officers' Quarters A and C, the SanFac, End of Corridor (the Armory's security door) and a dark Shipping Room (boxes of "Request Form Forms", ha). The ladder down from Level Six reaches the Printing Plant (Level Seven), but going further down, the ladder passage to Level Eight is "sealed off, apparently from below". The elevator comes when called, but typing 8 on its keypad only makes it whine. There are recurring vibrations and a feeling of dread from below: the pyramid must be on Level Eight or Nine. Level Five north is a Workshop with a twenty-ohm bedistor. With the hyperdiodes and fromitz boards I carry, it smells like a repair job somewhere. I haven't found the "hole" for the explosive yet. Theories: the sealed ladder passage, the elevator shaft, or a bank vault (the detector beeped in the bank).

**Cmds 176-212.** Left both hyperdiodes in the Workshop to free my hands. Found Station Control (monitors: Communication, Food, Power and Printing all RED) and a boring File Room. Back in the village I ran an experiment: with the detector on and the foil left behind, the Travel Agency was silent; carrying only the foil, it beeped. **The reflective foil is platinum**, my shield against the pyramid. Ate the gray goo (tree-mold custard). Floyd is getting nastier: shoving, cursing, stomping on my foot. The pyramid's influence, I bet. Saved in the Bank. Still missing a detonator and a way down to Level Eight. Next: the Pawn Shop, Doc Schuster's and the Loan Shark.

**Cmds 213-262.** Pawn Shop and Loan Shark: empty. Doc Schuster's has a 20 cm disposal hole in the wall and an unsigned letter ("ostrich nip... in my ceiling panel"). The Pet Store's ceiling panel is empty (presumably I emptied it before this checkpoint). The Junk Yard proper is down from Shady Dan's, so the "Junk Yard" line printed over the Studio was a stray heading. Found the Opium Den (a defaced anti-drug poster), and the Flophouse with a bed, a locker and a bag of vacuum taffy. Getting to sleep took several idle clicks. Slept: a nightmare of Floyd refusing to open the pod bay doors (lovely), then Day 3, and my chronometer has mysteriously stopped. Saved in the Flophouse.

**Cmds 263-305.** Broadway: Fortune Teller (the crystal ball holds a con artist's tip sheet, ha), Recruitment Office, Rec Shop (simulation booths, off). The Makeshift Connector leads to East Connection, whose iris is frozen fully open, so a space suit can probably pass that way. Comm Center: the screen tells me to abort my assignment and go home, the forms were found (lovely irony). There's an emergency beacon button I left alone. Sick Bay has a security door east; the ID reader said my card's magnetic data is damaged. Shady Dan's machine said the same: "scrambled", footnote "GOTCHA AGAIN!" (the Planetfall magnet joke). Magnetic boots plus card in my pocket? To test, I restarted the checkpoint and went straight to Shady Dan's: **the card is already scrambled at checkpoint start.** Filed as a bug. The restart also threw away my Flophouse save, which hurt. Plato's ambush came again (Floyd saved me after I pleaded, +7, 58).

**Cmds 306-350.** Tried the jammer (it switches on, frequency 0-1400, set to 710) at Shady Dan's and in the elevator: typing 8 still only makes the elevator whine. The suit won't pass the Makeshift Connector hatch either, although East Connection calls that same hatch "frozen open". Tried the empty elevator shaft (called the car up to Six, then entered the shaft from Seven): "You float helplessly", even in magnetic boots. Found a mauve nanofilm spool ("Collater Repair Manual") in the Printing Plant and a lilac one ("Spacetruck Refueling Instructions") in Docking Bay #3. There must be a spool reader somewhere. Level Four: Female and Male Barracks, SanFac, nothing useful. Floyd is openly hostile now ("Oh, quit jabbering already").

**Cmds 351-390.** Level Three: the Gym sign says the exercise machine talks on **frequency 710**, the same setting as my jammer. The Theatre has a locked projection booth (zapgun won't open the lock). In the Chapel (someone's earlier stash): a spray can of spores, a seven-pointed star with an open back, a leash, an Arcturian balloon creature, a puce spool ("Chapel Maintenance Procedures"). A pulpit switch relit the eternal flame and scared the balloon out. The Laundry presser has started billowing steam at me. Above the Mess Hall: Meeting Rooms 1-2 (shot Welder #2), the **Library with the voice-output nanofilm reader** (the terminal has been removed; shot Welder #3), and the **Dome**, where a "Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies" bin has a newly welded lock and is warm to the touch, next to an air-shaft grating. Saved in the Dome. My headlamp is starting to dim.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- **Village (zero-g):** Trading Post (hub: N Grocery, E Saloon, W Studio [sculpture], NW Pet Store, SE Shady Dan's [card machine, keypad 0-9999], SW Greasy Straw, Down Warehouse). Warehouse: SW Alley, Down Airlock, then the vac yard (needs suit + closed kit). Alley: N Missionary, S Loan Shark, E Junk Yard (Up to Shady Dan's), SE Doc Schuster's, SW Pawn Shop, NW/Up Main Street. Main Street: N Grimy Passage (then N South Connection; the suit can't pass), S Bank (platinum detector), W Travel Agency, Up Mayor's Office. Saloon: E Casino (N Opium Den, Up Flophouse: bed, locker, taffy). Grocery: N Broadway (N Recruitment, NE Rec Shop, Down Fortune Teller, W Makeshift Connector, then East Connection; the suit can't pass).
- **Station:** L3 lobby: N Gym, S Theatre (locked booth), NW Laundry, SW Chapel, Up Mess Hall (NE Meeting 1, S Meeting 2, S Library; SE Library; Up Dome). L4: barracks, Docking Bay #3. L5: N Workshop, then Storage; SE South Junction (E Station Control, SW File Room, S South Connection). East Connection: S Comm Center, NW Sick Bay (security door E). L6: N Aux Barracks, S Officers' Qtrs A, SanFac, C; NW Docking Bay #1 (alien ship: dots), SW Docking Bay #4, SE End of Corridor (N Armory security door, E Shipping Room). L7 Printing Plant (NW Paper Recycling). **The ladder down to L8 is sealed from below; the elevator refuses 8 and 9.**

### Puzzles solved
- Plato's ambush: keep telling Floyd "save me" / "help" every turn. Silence gets you killed (+7).
- The explosive has to be carried in the Thermos, taken out of the kit before you depressurize. It still softens, so it's on a clock.
- Alien dots + Mayor's glossary: the pyramid's weakness is element 78 (platinum). The detector test shows the **reflective foil is platinum**.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **The ID card is scrambled at checkpoint start** (a bug? see friction). Security doors (Sick Bay E, Armory) are closed to me.
- Where do the explosive, timer and detonator go? Candidates: the **Dome bin's welded lock** (warm, suspicious), the Theatre booth lock. I haven't found a detonator anywhere.
- How to reach Level 8/9: the sealed ladder, the elevator whining. Maybe the Dome's air-shaft grating is another route down.
- Spools (mauve, lilac, puce) plus the Library reader: play them for hints.
- Jammer on 710 = the exercise machine's diagnostic frequency. Jam the machine?

**Late find (cmd 393):** entering the Dome's air-shaft grating says "Impossible, unless you can pass through holes a centimeter across." The explosive is pencil-sized, and the sheet says "insert explosive in hole of appropriate diameter". **Best theory: blow the Dome grating and go down the air shaft past the sealed levels to 8/9.**

**End of leg (400/400):** last save is in the Library, next to the nanofilm reader. Score 58 on this run (61 was my best, in the run that was later discarded); Day 2; not won. The explosive is still out in the vac yard, untouched in this run. The space suit was left in the Makeshift Connector.

### What I would try next
Restore the latest save (Library). Try the grating (open/enter). Put the spools in the Library reader. Look for a detonator (perhaps the seven-pointed star, or inside the bin). Then fetch the explosive (drop the suit at the Warehouse, cycle the airlock, use the Thermos) and hurry it to whichever lock is the target.

### What I would try next

friction.result: The food in the survival kit instantly crystallizes and drifts away.
friction.why: Fair and funny, but the airlock stencil was my only warning; undo saved me. Good canon moment.

friction.result: The explosive suddenly sublimes into a puff of FREZONE gas. (...the game can no longer be won.)
friction.why: The only temperature warning is on the instruction sheet in the next room, and Plato's ambush ate the turns I'd have used to get it back outside. Harsh, but the unwinnable notice is a real kindness.

friction.result: (The explosive is gone for good... the game can no longer be won. Start again...)
friction.why: Telling me plainly that I'm dead-ended saves hours of wandering; exactly what a modern player needs.

friction.result: 'Junk Yard / You have entered a cluttered space bubble ... Oops ... scrap sculpture' then '## Studio' with a second full description
friction.why: Two room headings and two descriptions in one move; I wasn't sure which room I was in until the status line said Studio. The joke works, but the double header reads like a glitch.

friction.result: Floyd burst into tears and dashes out of the room. A beam leaps from the gun... You have died
friction.why: Run 1 I pestered Floyd and he saved me; run 2 I sat quiet and died. The '(you can still speak)' line is the only clue that talking to Floyd matters. Fair-ish, but a one-turn undo was all that let me recover without replaying 60 moves.

friction.result: (Even sealed in the Thermos bottle, the explosive is getting softer.)
friction.why: A clear, timely warning that the Thermos only buys time. Now I know to find the target before carrying it around.

friction.command: examine explosive (after several turns back in the vac yard, out of the Thermos)
friction.result: The explosive seems to be getting softer and losing its shape.
friction.why: Back in hard vacuum it still says 'getting softer' turn after turn. I can't tell whether space refreezes it or the fuse is still burning, so I don't know whether it's safe to leave or urgent to use.

friction.result: Well, there are openings in ALMOST every direction.
friction.why: The joke is good, but a compass button labelled 'special' promises something and delivers a wall. Made me think there was a secret.

friction.command: examine hatch, then look for the slot
friction.result: 'There's a slot next to the hatch.' but no slot appears in the room list, and ID card > Put it in... offers only Thermos and jammer
friction.why: In click mode I can't try the obvious 'put ID card in slot' on the Grimy Passage iris hatch. The prose names a thing the interface won't let me touch.

friction.command: taste dots (alien ship), decoded with the Mayor's glossary
friction.result: Hunji message: sabotage failed; Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78; turn back the deadly radiations
friction.why: A lovely puzzle: glossary in one place, message in another, and the platinum detector in the bank ties it together. Felt clever solving it.

friction.command: carry the reflective foil alone into the Travel Agency with the platinum detector on
friction.result: The detector is quietly beeping. (It was silent there without the foil.)
friction.why: A clean, testable deduction: foil = element 78. The detector reporting each turn made the experiment easy.

friction.command: sleep (in the Flophouse bed, 14 moves before tiredness)
friction.result: You're not tired. (You'll be able to sleep once you are tired, in about 14 moves.)
friction.why: The hint is clear, but WAIT only passes about one move per click, so I either burn a dozen clicks in bed or walk away and come back. A 'wait until sleepy' option would help in click mode.

friction.command: put ID card in slot (Shady Dan's machine); earlier, put card in Sick Bay ID reader
friction.result: 'Magnetic card data is scrambled; unable to read.' Footnote: GOTCHA AGAIN!
friction.why: The checkpoint starts me wearing magnetic boots with the ID card in my uniform pocket, so I never had a chance to avoid the scramble, and I don't know if the card was ruined before I took over. No 'no longer winnable' notice either, so I can't tell whether I'm dead-ended.

friction.command: (fresh checkpoint 06-plato) up, se, put ID card in slot of Shady Dan's machine as the first real action
friction.result: Magnetic card data is scrambled; unable to read. (Footnote 15: GOTCHA AGAIN!)
friction.why: Reproduced from a fresh checkpoint: the 06-plato checkpoint starts with the ID card already scrambled (boots worn, card in uniform). If the card is needed later, every run from this checkpoint is dead on arrival and the game never says so.

friction.command: restart > 'Yes, start this checkpoint again', then Restore
friction.result: Restore is gone from the buttons; my Flophouse save from the earlier run is no longer offered
friction.why: The other restart option says '(your saved position is kept)', which implies this one drops it, but that's only implied. I restarted just to test something and lost ~250 moves of progress.

friction.command: west through the Makeshift Connector hatch wearing the space suit
friction.result: The space suit is too bulky to fit through the partially dilated iris hatch.
friction.why: From the station side, East Connection says this hatch is 'frozen open', which I read as fully open, so I expected the suit to pass. The two descriptions of the same hatch don't agree.

friction.result: The bin is closed... A lock has been newly welded to the bin. The bin is warm to the touch.
friction.why: A strong, specific clue: something worth hiding is in there, and a welded lock is a natural 'hole' for the FREZONE explosive. Good signposting.

friction.result: You'll have to open the dryer first.
friction.why: The menu offered 'Look inside' on a closed dryer, and the boots menu offered 'Wear' on boots I was already wearing. Small, but it makes click menus feel less trustworthy.

friction.result: Impossible, unless you can pass through holes a centimeter across.
friction.why: A lovely 'aha': ties the pencil-sized explosive and the 'hole of appropriate diameter' instruction to this grating. It came at the very end of my budget, but it's the best clue I found for getting below Level Seven.

# Playtest round 5: triage

Generated by `node scripts/playtest-registry.mjs report 5` from playtests/REGISTRY.jsonl and the round's friction JSONL. Do not edit by hand; re-run it.

88 friction rows this round (37 of them praise, counted and not triaged); 51 linked to 42 issues (24 new, 18 repeats); 0 not yet linked.

By tier: 12 A, 3 B, 27 C.

Suggested A/B/C is the registry's guess from the kind (A: build it, B: a deviation for the sponsor, C: leave it as the original). **Norm confirms each one** (`confirm <id> A|B|C`) after checking it against the ZIL and the oracle.

## New issues

| Issue | Title | Area / room | Kind | Rows this round | Rows in all | Rounds | Suggested | Norm confirms | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SF-110 | SF-038's eat note on the coffee's refusal reads as "come back and drink it", and the coffee is poisoned | Survival / Mess Hall | confusing | 2 | 2 | 5 | B | A | open | Our own deviation (Q5 default, SF-038). COFFEE-F answers EAT with NOT-HUNGRY while HUNGER-LEVEL is 0 and otherwise kills: "Aaarghhh! The coffee is poisoned!" (station.zil 1760-1766). rules/levels234.js:248 (COFFEE) calls NOT-HUNGRY-NOTE after the refusal, so the note "(You'll be able to eat once you are hungry, in about N moves.)" brought two testers back to drink it when hungry; both died (UNDO saved them). Fix: no note on the coffee; NOT-HUNGRY-NOTE only from V-EAT on real food (library.js V_EAT, FOOD-DESC). The canon refusal stays. |
| SF-111 | D28 drill warning: "Drill again to carry on here" read as "drill anything again", and the next drilling spent the drill on the storage bin | Village / Dome | blocked | 1 | 1 | 5 | A | A | open | Our own deviation (D28 drill, rules/level5.js:100-108). The warning is one-time and global (g.state.drillWarned), so after it any next DRILL makes the one hole wherever it is. The tester drilled the lock, got the warning, then drilled the bin (the same HOUSING, station.zil 2140-2141, reading "here" as "the same job"), and the D28 backstop said the game could no longer be won (undone). Fix: tie the warning to the thing drilled, so drilling a different thing warns again, and say what the next drilling spends, never naming the safe, e.g. "(This drill has one hole left in it. Drill the storage bin again to spend it there.)". The one-hole rule stays the original's (MAKE-HOLE-WITH-DRILL, station.zil 996-1011). |
| SF-112 | D28 boots warning stops the take with no word of how to go ahead | Village / Junk Yard | confusing | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | A | open | Our own deviation (D28 boots, rules/library.js BOOTS_WARN 1322-1345). The warning refuses the action once and the next try scrambles as the original does (V-TAKE, verbs.zil 1917-1927; BOOTS-F, village.zil 1933-1943), but it never says the next try goes ahead. Fix: one bracketed tail per action: "(Take them again to go ahead.)"; "(Take it again to go ahead.)" for the card; "(Take them off again to go ahead.)"; "(Wear them again to go ahead.)" for WEAR's implied take (parser.js:1863). |
| SF-113 | EXAMINE EXPLOSIVE back in vacuum still says it is "getting softer", so the player cannot tell whether it is safe | Village / In Space | confusing | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | B | open | The original, not SF-084's line. SF-084's bracketed line (rules/villageB.js:536-544) printed once, at its threshold, while sealed (r5-click-06plato command 112), and never after the explosive was gone (command 46). The repeated line is EXPLOSIVE-F's EXAMINE: past 130 it adds DESCRIBE-EXPLOSIVE (village.zil 1387-1389, 1424-1430). MELT-COUNTER never goes down, and opening the outer door with the explosive there dequeues I-EXPLOSIVE-MELT (village.zil 1209-1210), so in vacuum it has stopped melting but still reads "getting softer" (commands 123-130; our engine and the ZIL agree). Proposal (Q11), behind the D12 switch: while the melt is stopped (I-EXPLOSIVE-MELT not queued) and the counter is past 130, EXAMINE adds "(Out here in the cold, it has stopped softening.)". The canon line stays. |
| SF-114 | "Start this checkpoint again" silently discards the saved position | Harness / Shady Dan's | confusing | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | A | open | Harness only. scripts/playtest.mjs startCheckpoint calls applyCheckpoint, whose g.load replaces the whole state (engine/core.js:860), so saveSlot and saveSlots go. The page's restart keeps them (Game.restart, core.js:861-863: a saved game outlived RESTART in 1987), and "Yes, start again" says "(your saved position is kept)". Fix: carry saveSlot and saveSlots over on the checkpoint restart, as Game.restart does, and label "Start this checkpoint again" the same way. No warning needed then. |
| SF-115 | Reading a footnote uses up the one-step UNDO | Page / Dome | bug | 1 | 1 | 5 | A | A | open | Our own D18 UNDO (engine/core.js:759-765) snapshots before every line. V-FOOTNOTE takes no time: <SETG C-ELAPSED 0> (verbs.zil 954-955), and the original notes "FOOTNOTE turns don't run clocker" (verbs.zil 1006). So FOOTNOTE 9 after the shot replaced the snapshot, and UNDO took back only the footnote (transcript 298-300; the zapgun stayed at 6). Fix: do not replace undoSnap for a FOOTNOTE line (nor for the harness's paper views, which take no turn); UNDO then takes back the last real move. |
| SF-116 | 06-plato starts with the ID card already scrambled (boots worn, card in the uniform) | Village / Shady Dan's | bug | 2 | 2 | 5 | A | C | left | The route's real state, not a checkpoint bug. data/checkpoints/06-plato.json has ID-SCRAMBLED true, ID-RANK 8 and scored:ARMORY: the seed-1 route took the zapgun at step 138 (route-seed1.cmds 124-138), then at 246-247 took and wore the boots with the card in the uniform, which scrambles it (V-TAKE, verbs.zil 1917-1927). The route never uses the card after 138, so the stage is winnable from the checkpoint: the walkthrough gate plays it to 80 of 80. The D28 backstop rightly stays silent, since the zapgun is already taken (REPEAT-C-ANALYSIS.md section 1). Kept. |
| SF-117 | The blueprints (a full map) sit unnoticed behind the Papers button | Page / Theatre | confusing | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | A | open | Interface. The blueprints were in the 1987 package, in the player's hands (reference/, the feelies); the page shows them under Papers… with the forms. Testers found them late in round 1 (r1-click-03village#15, praise), here after about 250 commands, and click diaries in rounds 1-5 mention finding them late. Fix: name them on the button, "Papers & blueprints…", on the page and the harness surface. No game text changes. |
| SF-118 | Harness: a menu closes after any action taken from it, so Examine then Take reopens it | Harness / Robot Shop | tedious | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | C | left | Interface, kept. A turn closes the open menu (SF-046), as the page's menu closes after a choice (ui.js showMenu); stale numbers ran old entries before SF-046. Kept. |
| SF-119 | Take all picks up things dropped on purpose, and tries Floyd and Plato | Parser / Pet Store | tedious | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | C | left | The original: TAKE ALL tries everything in the room, the robots included (oracle, seed 1, route step 120: "Floyd: You can't reach Floyd from the bed.", then Plato and every thing; SF-040). "Drop all except…" (ui.js:177) is the page's reverse. Kept. |
| SF-120 | Harness: "<menu> <number> <value>" is refused for a number-taking entry (538 549 1) | Harness / Shady Dan's | parse | 1 | 1 | 5 | A | A | open | Harness only. resolveClick (scripts/playtest.mjs, SF-097) takes "<menu> <number>" only when the rest is all digits, so "549 1" (the keypad's number entry, then the value) falls to label matching and is refused; "538" then "549 1" worked. Fix: when the rest starts with a number the open menu lists, take that entry and pass what follows as its value, as SF-061 does for "<keypad> <pad> <number>". |
| SF-121 | Opening the outer airlock door in a space suit without the boots: blown out, "Lost in Space" | Village / Junk Yard | blocked | 1 | 1 | 5 | A | C | left | The original: the outer door opening with the suit worn but not the boots: ", taking you along for the ride." then LOST-IN-SPACE (village.zil 1204-1206, 1331). The D28 airlock notice is about containers only. Kept (D28 item 4: fast informed deaths stay). |
| SF-122 | Put it in… lists every container held, the drill among them, for the explosive | Click menus / Warehouse | confusing | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | C | left | Interface, kept on D15 (no entry marks a puzzle): Put it in… lists every container drawn, and the refusal is the original's. The explosive still in hand shows in the inventory panel. Kept. |
| SF-123 | The Grimy Passage hatch says "There's a slot next to the hatch", but there is no slot to use | Village / Grimy Passage | blocked | 1 | 1 | 5 | A | C | left | The original. IRIS-HATCH-F's EXAMINE text, shared with the station side, names the slot (village.zil 42-50); the slot pseudo (FORM-SLOT-F) is only in the station rooms (station.zil 478, 1095), and GRIMY-PASSAGE has none (village.zil 836-845), so a typed PUT CARD IN SLOT there cannot see a slot either. The click list matches. Kept. |
| SF-124 | Click mode has no way to wait until tired: each Wait is one move | Survival / Flophouse | tedious | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | B | open | The original: V-WAIT is 40 millichrons (verbs.zil 2449-2455) and V-WAIT-UNTIL only answers HUH (verbs.zil 2470-2471), so a typed player also waits one WAIT at a time. The SF-064 note already says when sleep will work. Proposal (Q11), behind the D12 switch: a "Wait until tired" entry beside the bed while the sleep refusal applies, through the existing "Wait for…" button (core.js:842-850, rules.waitFor), which stops on anything that interrupts a wait. |
| SF-125 | East Connection calls the hatch "frozen open", but the space suit is too bulky for the partly dilated hatch | Village / Makeshift Connector | confusing | 1 | 1 | 5 | B | C | left | The original: "frozen open" (station.zil 487) and "too bulky to fit through the partially dilated iris hatch" (village.zil 13-14). Kept. |
| SF-126 | Wear is offered on boots already worn | Click menus / Dome | other | 1 | 1 | 5 | C | A | open | Interface. At the 06-plato checkpoint the worn boots' menu reads Examine, Take off, Look inside, Wear, More… (surface replayed, seed 31634). zmenus offers WEAR only while not WORNBIT (engine/zmenus.js:272, 382), so a second path (the D28 WEAR take or BOOTS-F's answered verbs) adds it. Fix: never offer Wear on a worn thing. Look inside on the closed dryer stays: the original's refusal says to open it. |
| SF-127 | Round 5 vocabulary: seats, stockpiles, organic, bunk, mayor, and "ask for X" | Parser / Theatre | parse | 5 | 5 | 5 | A | A | open | D28 item 6, the standing rule: words the game prints. Oracle, seed 1: [I don't know the word "seats."], and the same for "stockpiles", "stockpile", "organic" and "bunk"; ASK FOR EXPLOSIVE gives [That sentence isn't one I recognize.] (the only ASK FOR syntax needs an actor, syntax.zil 96).
